items.title: How To Use Decision Models for Evals
items.excerpt: Decision models have exploded onto the scene recently, starting with TypeSafe’s Jev, followed by Perplexity’s Decider, Liquid’s d1, Cloudflare’s Clef, and OpenAI’s Decisions API. These models promise fast, inexpensive classification. Decision models are an appealing low-cost alternative to LLM judges for automated evals.
